subject: HSM seal & operator chain-of-custody package (requested artifacts and next steps)
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@clearpeak.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearpeak.com
Date: 2028-04-12T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Request: operator separation + rotation artifacts for SIG review

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our security review team has a few follow-ups focused on HSM custody and operator controls to close out the SIG/CAIQ questions. Can you provide:  

- A current operator role matrix (names/titles/shift windows) showing separation of duties between HSM operators and platform engineers.  
- A 30-day sample of rotation events (key-wrapping / key-rotation / KEK wrap) with hashes/time and the correlating operator id. We only need excerpts that show the workflow (do not include raw key material).
- Sample tamper/seal event logs (if any) and a short explanation of physical attestation process used during key ceremonies.
- A signed attestation (PDF) confirming that Redwood retains no unwrapped tenant keys for BYOK customers and a pointer to the KMS/HSM vendor attestation.

We can accept an SFTP drop or secure link. Ideally delivered by EOD Tuesday 4/15 so SOC2/SIG review can proceed with our control owner. If you need a narrow scoping call to prioritize, I'm available tomorrow morning.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Security Controls Lead, ClearPeak Technologies

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@clearpeak.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator separation + rotation artifacts for SIG review

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a scoped package that meets those points. High-level plan:  

1) Operator matrix: CSV listing current HSM operator roles, on-call windows, HR role mappings (we will obfuscate personal identifiers per your preference) — attached as "hsm-operator-matrix.csv".

2) Rotation events: we'll export rotation event metadata (event id, timestamp, operator id, operation type, resulting wrapped-key-hash) for a 30-day window. We will redact tenant identifiers and will not include any wrapped key blobs — sample excerpt to be delivered as "rotation-events-2028-03-excerpt.log".

3) Tamper/seal and ceremony notes: short write-up describing physical seal checks we perform, vendor HSM attestation references, and an SFTP pointer to the ceremony manifest ("byok-handshake-manifest.txt").

4) Signed attestation: CTO-signed PDF confirming no unwrapped tenant key custody + link to vendor HSM attestation. We'll provide a DocuSign link for signature and a PDF copy named "redwood-attestation-signed.pdf".

We can push the package to the SFTP location below by EOD 4/15, and I'm happy to do a 30-minute walkthrough with your control owner on 4/16 if they'd like to validate artifacts. Proposed SFTP: sftp://evidence.clearpeak.redwood/clearpeak/2028-04-15/

Can you confirm the artifacts above are sufficient (or whether you need operator shift rosters with anonymized IDs)?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: operator separation + rotation artifacts for SIG review

Folks — forwarding ClearPeak asks. Timeline is tight (EOD 4/15). Ops can generate exports but we need to confirm redaction rules and SFTP creds. Action items:  

- Ben: can you own exporting rotation event metadata from the KMS/HSM audit service and place the redacted excerpt in the SFTP path? Include event-id, iso-time, op-code, operator-id-mask, wrapped-key-hash. Do NOT include key material or tenant ids.
- Jonas: please coordinate with infra to pull the tamper/seal logs from the HSM vendor portal and prepare the ceremony manifest with step-by-step checks. Attach vendor attestation PDF link.
- Marissa: I'll prepare the operator matrix CSV and generate HR role mappings with obscured email addresses.

We should also prepare a one-page attestation for CTO signature. I'll draft language and attach to this thread. Ben/Jonas let me know ETA for your pieces by EOD 4/14 so we can assemble and push 4/15 morning.

—Marissa

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@clearpeak.com>

Date: 2028-04-15T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Delivery: HSM custody package and attestation (SFTP link + excerpts)

Hi Alicia — package has been uploaded to the SFTP path below. Summary of delivered items and quick notes inline. Please confirm receipt.

SFTP: sftp://evidence.clearpeak.redwood/clearpeak/2028-04-15/
Contents uploaded (stubs):
- hsm-operator-matrix.csv (columns: operator_id_mask, role, team, shift_start_utc, shift_end_utc, hr_role_map)
- rotation-events-2028-03-excerpt.log (redacted event metadata; see excerpt below)
- byok-handshake-manifest.txt (ceremony checklist + vendor attestation pointer)
- redwood-attestation-signed.pdf (CTO-signed; DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.net/01ABCDEFG-Redwood-Attestation)

Sample rotation excerpt (redacted):
[2028-03-04T02:12:17Z] EVENT_ID=evt-9f2a0 | OP=KEK_WRAP | OPERATOR=op-17c | WRAPPED_HASH=sha256:fa34...c2d1
[2028-03-12T11:05:02Z] EVENT_ID=evt-9f9b3 | OP=KEY_ROTATE | OPERATOR=op-04a | WRAPPED_HASH=sha256:5b2e...a8f3

Notes:  
- We verified no unwrapped tenant key artifacts are included. The wrapped hashes are deterministic hashes of the wrapped material and are safe to share for control verification.
- Tamper logs: no tamper/seal failures in the requested window; vendor HSM attestation (FIPS/HSM vendor cert) referenced inside the manifest.
- Operator matrix includes masked operator IDs (op-XX) to preserve PII — if you require full HR names under an NDA, we can provide a controlled disclosure route.

Next steps: if the control owner wants a short proof walkthrough, I can join a 30-min call on 4/16 at 10:00am PT. Otherwise, confirm whether the artifacts close your SIG questions and we'll mark this item cleared.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
